svg.text: Mobile ground-control truck · S.Sgt. Dana Reyes — contestant vehicle dossier
“I had eyes on for nineteen days. I knew his kids’ names.”
Roof: antennas, satellite dome, Ku-band mast
Windows are screens — she drives by camera
The courtyard photo, taped to the monitor
A desert-tan armored communications box truck
bristling with roof antenna arrays, a satellite
dome and a tall Ku-band mast, its windows
replaced by dark camera screens, utilitarian and
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~55k tris · PBR 4K
